Button.default: n/a(stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11; the tokens are the Button state variables in button.css)
Button.hover: n/a(stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11; the tokens are the Button state variables in button.css)
Button.focus: n/a(stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11; the tokens are the Button state variables in button.css)
Button.active: n/a(stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11; the tokens are the Button state variables in button.css)
Button.disabled: n/a(stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11; the tokens are the Button state variables in button.css)
Button.loading: n/a(stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11; the tokens are the Button state variables in button.css)
Button.selected: n/a(stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11; the tokens are the Button state variables in button.css)
Button.error: n/a(a button has no value to validate; errors show in the form message area)

DataGrid.error: n/a(a stylesheet-only change here; error states live in the part's own rules)

Resizable.error: n/a(a stylesheet-only change here; error states live in the part's own rules)

AnswerLines.error: n/a(a static block: no interaction, no value)

PageBreak.error: n/a(a static marker: no interaction, no value)

CodeEditor.active: n/a(a text area has no pressed state)
CodeEditor.loading: n/a(the code is given; nothing loads)
CodeEditor.selected: n/a(text selection is the browser's; no row stays selected)
CodeEditor.error: n/a(invalid is the is-invalid state set by its Field; stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11)

CodeBlock.error: n/a(a type-only change: the prop type is exported)

RefineMenu.error: n/a(a type-only change: the prop type is exported)

SuggestedEdit.error: n/a(a type-only change: the prop type is exported)

DocumentViewer.disabled: n/a(a viewer has nothing to disable; its toolbar buttons disable at the first and last page)
DocumentViewer.selected: n/a(a thumbnail marks the current page, which is the page state, not a selection)

Menu.loading: n/a(a menu opens with its items; an async list is the caller's loading state)
Menu.selected: n/a(a checked or radio item shows a check mark; no row stays selected)
Menu.error: n/a(a menu has no value to validate)

EventChip.disabled: n/a(a chip is plain text or a button; it has no disabled state)
EventChip.loading: n/a(an event is shown as given; nothing loads)
EventChip.selected: n/a(an event chip does not stay selected)
EventChip.error: n/a(a chip has no value to validate)

Checklist.active: n/a(a task is a native checkbox: its pressed look is the browser's)
Checklist.loading: n/a(tasks are given; persistence belongs to the caller)
Checklist.selected: n/a(a completed task is its checked state)
Checklist.error: n/a(a checklist has no value to validate)

ProductOptions.active: n/a(its tiles, swatches and stepper are the RadioTiles, ColorSwatch and NumberInput parts: their states)
ProductOptions.selected: n/a(a chosen value is the option's value; the parts show it)
ProductOptions.error: n/a(an option's error shows as its message under it; stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11)

Tabs.loading: n/a(the tabs and panels are given; an async panel is the caller's loading state)
Tabs.error: n/a(tabs have no value to validate)

Tree.disabled: n/a(a tree item has no disabled state)
Tree.loading: n/a(a branch loading its children shows a status row from useBranchLoader; stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11)
Tree.error: n/a(a branch that failed to load shows a status row and retries; stories arrive with Storybook, P0-11)
